items.subject: Sunset Beach River Park

existing.sourceName: Sonoma County Regional Parks — park page and tubing guide
existing.directions: 11403 River Road, Forestville. Follow the park’s signed beach access; the marker is the park directions destination, not the river landing.
existing.note: Public hand-carry river access is documented by the county. Coordinates come from its Get Directions link and identify the park approach. The exact seasonal beach landing is not verified; no boat-ramp or takeout-bank claim is made.

items.nextAction: Find the current county beach-access trail terminus and a source tying it to the usable takeout. Keep the county park destination approximate. Do not promote the old midstream response-strategy coordinate. Recheck river length after the landing is established.
items.note: Current county park page lists 11403 River Road; the older response plan lists a different address and additional upstream responder access. These cannot be assumed equivalent.
